objective: v1.2 small-capital construction: can the unchanged v1.2 M0_U3000 book run in a $50,000 Alpaca account (fractional DAY-order longs, whole-share ETB shorts) and keep >= 0.80 of the full $1M account's recent Sharpe (F1 excess over BIL, F2 information ratio over SPY), with V2 feasibility, by concentrating to the top-K names per side (R1, R1B) or by dropping the short stock leg (R3)?
target_regime_and_horizon: US equities, the v1.2 M0_U3000 book (weekly 5 tranches, decision at close D, fill at close D+1), account simulation 2017-10-02..2026-09-15; recent window 2024-01-08..2026-09-15 decides, stress window 2017-10-02..2023-08-31 is reported and used only as a crash diagnostic (stress retention >= 0.60 for the same_strategy class). Deployment horizon: the owner's extra paper account from 2026-10-15.
existing_solution_comparison: Practice for small accounts is to round long and short books separately (PyPortfolioOpt DiscreteAllocation) or to hold fewer names (direct-index vendors, 150-300 names); exact cardinality MIQPs do not scale (Murray-Shek 2012, read by I-20261005-01). Nobody publishes a verified small long-short account record (I-20261005-01 evidence tier 0). Our own T-71 measured only one day's rounding feasibility (top-200 per side passes V2 at $50,000, top-300 fails), not the Sharpe cost, which is what this contract measures.
remaining_evidence_gap: (1) Sharpe retention and tracking error of the concentrated book over 2017-2026 at $25k/$50k/$100k; (2) whether the short leg earns its whole-share cost (R1 vs R3); (3) whether top-K by weight beats random K names (placebo); (4) turnover and order counts of a 15:50 DAY-order book at small capital.
negative_experiments_checked: Registry check 'small capital concentrated top-N long short whole share fractional' found no duplicate (best match 0.44, unrelated). Local: v1 Stage 2a and RF1 refuted on construction (t20261001_book_v1 decision record), so this contract changes only capital, rounding and name count of the v1.2 construction that reached P1; v1.3 kept full rebalancing (no-trade bands failed E3), so the trading rule stays full rebalancing; T-19 pure price long-only books failed, so R3 keeps the v1.2 composite, not a price signal.
cost_and_execution_assumptions: Whole book as DAY orders around 15:50 ET (fractional longs cannot use opg/cls; paper matches at the NBBO), backtest fill at the close of D+1 with make_cost_fn('close') at the tier's own notional (D4 15:45 half-spreads, square-root impact, 0.5 bp fees); ETB shorts only, borrow 0 bp main and 25 bp sensitivity; 2x trading cost on the same path; Reg T and Alpaca maintenance margin as in the v1.2 account layer; long orders below $1 dropped (Alpaca minimum), short orders in whole shares.
stop_condition: Measurement with a mechanical classification (hypotheses.md section 9): same_strategy / related_strategy / not_deployable per form at $50,000, plus the minimum capital tier. Identity failure (I1 or I2) stops the run with status identity_failed. Not deployable is 'not at depth', never a refutation of v1.2.

cheapest_decisive_test.action: Brief T-20261005-37: identity I1/I2, then one local pass of 76 simulated accounts (16 candidates at $50k, 20 tier-sensitivity series, 40 placebo series), evaluation and classification.
cheapest_decisive_test.pass_condition: A form has a deployable config at $50,000: V2 feasibility, recent Sharpe retention >= 0.80 of the $1M account, 2x-cost recent excess return > 0 (same_strategy additionally TE <= 0.25 x vol and stress retention >= 0.60; related_strategy needs its own DSR >= 0.70 and placebo percentile >= 0.80).
cheapest_decisive_test.falsification_condition: No config keeps 0.80 of the recent Sharpe at $50,000 for either form: v1.2 is not deployable at the owner's capital with top-K concentration; report the minimum tier and move to the named follow-up.
